_comment: Simplified Chinese texts for the German table solenne. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns. Kept by hand; check with python3 tools/i18n/check_lang.py zh_CN.

strings.Sand howls through the wind towers: ever: 沙子在风塔间呼啸：前排所有非Stone属性的Spirling每回合损失少量元气。
strings.Take the sand road south from the Saltgl: 从Saltglass盐滩沿沙路南下前往Ochrewell，修复Solenne的三道裂隙。
strings.Teaches Dawn Mend to a Lumen Spirling. N: 教会Lumen属性Spirling Dawn Mend。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Radiant Lance to a Lumen Spirlin: 教会Lumen属性Spirling Radiant Lance。永不消耗。
strings.Teaches Squall to a Gale Spirling. Never: 教会Gale属性Spirling Squall。永不消耗。
strings.The last shutter opens, the tower breath: 最后一扇百叶窗打开，塔开始呼吸，楼梯畅通了！
strings.The oasis east of Ochrewell has run dry:: Ochrewell以东的绿洲干涸了：绿洲裂隙。守望者Kaia说这不怪任何人。
strings.The oasis has been sold dry: every heal: 绿洲被卖干了：双方所有治疗减半。
strings.The shutter bangs, and the wind drops de: 百叶窗砰地一响，风一下子死了。所有百叶窗又关上了。
strings.The shutter swings open. Sand hisses thr: 百叶窗打开了。沙子从缝隙间嘶嘶涌入。
strings.The shutters hum in the wind. The stair: 百叶窗在风中嗡嗡作响。楼梯一直开着。
strings.The sun stands straight overhead: Lumen: 太阳正当头顶：双方的Lumen技艺打得更狠。
strings.The sundial under the sun palace has sto: 太阳宫下的日晷停了：太阳裂隙。守望者Emrys在等着，慢慢地。
strings.The wind towers of Ochrewell have stoppe: Ochrewell的风塔停止了呼吸：高塔裂隙。守望者Aurelio哀伤得很有格调。
